narr: Heavy rain associated with weakening Hurricane Henri caused flash flooding in the Pennsylvania counties of Monroe and Northampton on the night of August 22. Rainfall totals were as high as 4 to 8 inches in the region.
ev: Gilbert Road in Gilbert was closed due to flooding.
Vehicles were trapped in flood waters in Middle Smithfield Township.
PA Route 611 was closed due to flooding in Delaware Water Gap at Mountain Road and Waring Drive.
Interstate 80 eastbound was closed between Tannersville and Bartonsville due to flooding. Golden Slipper Road and Miller Road in Jackson Township were closed due to flooding.
PA Route 611 was closed due to flooding in Upper Mount Bethel Township near Riverton Road. Fox Gap Road was closed at Creek Road in Upper Mount Bethel Township due to flooding.
Sullivan Trail Road in Pocono Township was closed due to flooding.
Fiddletown Road was closed due to flooding near Kunkletown.
Minor flooding occurred along the Bush Kill in Middle Smithfield Township.
Minor flooding occurred along the Brodhead Creek near East Stroudsburg.
Tobyhanna Creek overflowed its banks near Blakeslee.
Minor flooding occurred along the Pohopoco Creek at Kresgeville.
Vehicles were trapped in flood waters in Stroud Township. PA Route 447 was closed to the south of Analomink due to flooding.
Vehicles were trapped in flood waters in Smithfield Township. Little Sambo Creek was out of its banks, flooding some nearby properties in Smithfield Township.
